content: Jinja2 Environment accepts block_start_string/variable_start_string/comment_start_string to replace {% %}/{{ }}/{# #} (needed to avoid clashes with LaTeX braces); finalize is a callable applied to the result of every variable expression before output (usable for default LaTeX escaping); autoescape is HTML/XML-only; StrictUndefined raises on print/iteration/comparison of undefined values; trim_blocks/lstrip_blocks control whitespace. Jinja2 3.1.2 already installed in the Python 3.11 Store interpreter on this machine.
